title: LLM-Augmented Multi-Modal Fusion for SoC Design Space Exploration
problem: Complex SoC designs have vast design spaces; current approaches reduce microarchitectures to simple parameter vectors, losing rich information embedded in functional behaviors and implementation details.
motivation: More effective feature extraction from microarchitectures enables better design space exploration and optimization.
method: LLM-augmented multi-modal fusion combining domain-knowledge-enhanced LLM for semantic features (from natural language design descriptors) and graph neural network for structural features (from Chisel-compiled RTL); MLP with Monte Carlo dropout for uncertainty quantification; end-to-end training via Bayesian optimization.
key_novelty: Combining LLM semantic extraction with GNN structural analysis for richer microarchitecture representation in DSE.
contributions: LLM-based semantic feature extraction from design descriptors
GNN-based structural feature extraction from RTL
Multi-modal fusion with Monte Carlo dropout for uncertainty

metrics.other: Improved exploration efficiency and prediction quality under data limitations

limitations: Evaluated only on Gemmini-based RISC-V; generalization to other SoC designs unclear.
